# `PluginEvent::BuildHudForCell`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-event">event</span> <span class="sdk-kind">event</span>

Source: **Events** (`crates/flux_plugin_sdk/src/events.rs`). Generated group: **Events**.

## When It Fires

Fired when the engine asks plugins to contribute HUD lines for one cell.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cell` | UVec2 | `cell` field stored as `UVec2` on `BuildHudForCellEvent`. |

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/events/pluginevent-buildhudforcell.md`](../../examples/events/pluginevent-buildhudforcell.md)_

```rust
impl MyPlugin {
    fn on_build_hud_for_cell(
        &mut self,
        event: &BuildHudForCellEvent,
    ) -> Result<(), PluginError> {
        let pressure = self.gases.pressure_at(event.cell)?;
        self.ui.add_hud_line(
            self.hud_block_id.clone(),
            "Pressure probe".to_string(),
            format!("cell ({}, {}): {:.2} Pa", event.cell.x, event.cell.y, pressure),
        )
    }
}
```
